bio: One of only two Grade I listed hotels in the United Kingdom, the Royal Crescent is situated in the centre of John Wood's world famous Georgian architectural masterpiece.  Afternoon Tea can be served in their garden, Montagu's Mews Restaurant or on the outdoor heated terrace.  Their deliciously decadent Afternoon Tea includes a variety of tasty sandwiches, home-made cakes and scones along with your choice of tea or coffee.
